title: Evaluating Infrasonic Hemodynography
brief_summary: This comparative diagnostic accuracy study will determine the accuracy of a noninvasive wearable infrasonic sensor to detect the mechanical, electrical, and hemodynamic function of the cardiovascular system.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Normal Sinus Rhythm
* LV systolic function \>53%

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Known history of carotid artery disease
* 2\. Moderate or greater valvular disease in Group 1
* 3\. Other implantable devices (pacemaker, ICD, CardioMems, TENS unit, continuous glucose monitors, etc)
* 4\. Active arrhythmia
* 5\. Reduced Ejection Fraction (\< 35%) other than Group 4
* 6\. Hearing loss
